answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one harbor weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The atlas report shows the merge explicitly at each lagoon. Because of that, an attacker who spins up 217 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 96 times the capital for one share. A farm of 2941 identities would post 3211 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
